C5:
ENTERPRISE VALUE
What it is: market value of equity plus debt minus cash.
Quarterly reporters: E5 = E4 + 'Quarterly Data'!Q2 - 'Quarterly Data'!R2. E4 is Google Finance market capitalization; Q2 and R2 are the latest SEC quarter-end total debt and cash. Balance-sheet amounts are point-in-time, not four-quarter sums.
Annual-only reporters: E5 = 'Annual View'!B14 = (E3 × G6) + ('Financial Data'!R2 - 'Financial Data'!O2) × 'Annual View'!B4. E3 × G6 is market value using diluted ADR-equivalent shares; the debt and cash are from the latest fiscal year and converted to US dollars.
Missing required inputs show a dash; refresh in progress or failed hides the result.
F2:
LATEST REVENUE
What it is: revenue earned over the latest available reporting period.
Quarterly reporters: G2 = SUM('Quarterly Data'!D2:D5), using four consecutive SEC fiscal quarters (trailing twelve months, TTM).
Annual-only reporters: G2 = 'Annual View'!B10 = 'Financial Data'!B2 × 'Annual View'!B4, the latest fiscal-year revenue converted to US dollars at the Google Finance exchange rate (1 for USD).
Source: SEC filings imported into the data tabs. Missing amounts or incomplete periods show a dash; refresh in progress or failed hides the result.
F3:
LATEST NET INCOME
What it is: reported profit attributable to shareholders over the latest available reporting period.
Quarterly reporters: G3 = SUM('Quarterly Data'!E2:E5), using four consecutive SEC fiscal quarters (TTM).
Annual-only reporters: G3 = 'Annual View'!B11 = 'Financial Data'!C2 × 'Annual View'!B4, the latest fiscal-year net income converted to US dollars at the Google Finance exchange rate (1 for USD).
Source: SEC filings imported into the data tabs. Missing amounts or incomplete periods show a dash; refresh in progress or failed hides the result.
F4:
LATEST FREE CASH FLOW
What it is: operating cash flow remaining after capital expenditures.
Quarterly reporters: G4 = SUM('Quarterly Data'!I2:I5), using four consecutive SEC fiscal quarters (TTM). Each quarter's free cash flow = operating cash flow (G) - capital expenditures (H).
Annual-only reporters: G4 = 'Annual View'!B12 = 'Financial Data'!D2 × 'Annual View'!B4. Annual free cash flow = operating cash flow - capital expenditures, converted to US dollars at the Google Finance exchange rate (1 for USD).
Source: SEC cash-flow statements imported into the data tabs. Missing amounts or incomplete periods show a dash; refresh in progress or failed hides the result.
F5:
LATEST COMMON SHARES OUTSTANDING
What it is: actual common shares outstanding at the reported as-of date, rather than a weighted-average diluted share count.
Quarterly reporters: G5 = 'Quarterly Data'!U2, from the latest SEC report's cover-page shares outstanding. The as-of date is in V2.
Annual-only reporters: G5 = 'Annual View'!B35 = 'Quarterly Data'!Z8 ÷ 'Annual View'!B9. Z8 holds ordinary shares outstanding from the annual report, Z10 holds the as-of date, and B9 is ordinary shares per ADR. Dividing expresses the count in US-listed ADR equivalents.
Missing required inputs show a dash; refresh in progress or failed hides the result.
F6:
LATEST DILUTED SHARE COUNT
What it is: weighted-average diluted shares for the latest available quarter, or latest fiscal year for annual-only reporters. It includes the reported effect of potentially dilutive securities.
Quarterly reporters: G6 = 'Quarterly Data'!T2. For fiscal Q4, the data importer derives the count from the full-year and Q1–Q3 figures. If T2 is missing, the sheet's Q4 backstop is 4 × full-year diluted shares - SUM(Q1, Q2, Q3 diluted shares), accepted only when positive and within 10% of Q3.
Annual-only reporters: G6 = 'Annual View'!B13 = 'Financial Data'!E2 ÷ 'Annual View'!B9 (ordinary shares per ADR).
Source: SEC-reported weighted-average diluted shares and disclosed derivations. B22 selects G6 versus regular shares G5 for purchase-price calculations. Missing required inputs show a dash; refresh in progress or failed hides the result.
F7:
LATEST REPORTED PERIOD
What it is: the latest fiscal period in the imported SEC financial data, not a forecast or the date of the current market quote.
Quarterly reporters: G7 combines 'Quarterly Data'!B2 (quarter) and A2 (fiscal year) as Q[quarter] FY[year]. It appends X2 when available (SEC 8-K Item 2.02 earnings-results filing date), otherwise W2 (10-Q/10-K filing date). X2 is not necessarily the first public earnings-announcement date. C2 is the period end, not the disclosure date. The formula requires four consecutive quarters.
Annual-only reporters: G7 = 'Annual View'!B15, showing the latest fiscal year ('Financial Data'!A2) and year-end date (W2). A year-end older than 500 days is flagged as too old for valuations.
Missing required inputs show a dash; refresh in progress or failed hides the result.
A7:
SEC DATA STATUS
What it is: the import state and identity of the SEC financial snapshot used by the dashboard.
B7 compares UPPER(TRIM(B2)) with 'Quarterly Data'!Y2 (imported ticker). A mismatch hides calculated valuations. During refresh or failure, B7 shows the state and last successful import; valuations remain hidden until success.
On success, annual-year count = COUNT('Financial Data'!A2:A1000); quarter count = COUNT('Quarterly Data'!A2:A1000). The latest fiscal quarter/year comes from 'Quarterly Data'!B2/A2. Released uses X2 (SEC 8-K Item 2.02 filing date); SEC filed uses W2 (10-Q/10-K filing date). Last successful import time comes from Z2.
Annual-only reporters show the latest fiscal year and year end from 'Financial Data'!A2/W2, plus reporting currency from 'Quarterly Data'!Z4, instead of quarterly details.
